input.content: caos-expr: collapse the grammar onto a typed `--base`; add :docker=/:hash= Checkpoint 2B of the typed-argument work (design/flake-inputs.md). The `.caos-expr` surface no longer has a positional image or a `--`: a `run`/ `curry` is now `verb --base:= [--k…]`, where the reserved `--base` names the worker to run (or curry onto), typed like any other arg. This retires the last shape-sniffing on that surface — the image's kind is the operator's explicit choice, never guessed from the value. Arg-type vocabulary (crates/caos/src/lib.rs, parse_arg/ArgType): - :tree= -> :hash=, generalized from tree-only to a tree OR blob by oid. - new :docker=ref, stored as the blob `docker://` (the representation the server and base_arg_entry already expect). Both wired into build_arg_entries (CLI/worker args) and the evaluator. Evaluator (crates/caos/src/eval.rs): - eval_command scans the tokens after the verb for the one named `base` (no positional, no `--`); the rest are ordinary args. - resolve_expr_image -> resolve_expr_base, dispatching on the explicit ArgType (docker / hash / path / $VAR) instead of sniffing. - resolve_expr_args handles :docker= and :hash=. Module grammar doc updated. Migrated every .caos-expr to the new grammar: all 14 committed ones (the root, std/, and std/*/ — including the multi-line curry/variable form in std/llm-step), plus the fixtures that tests write at runtime in tests/{eval-path,secrets,deep-deps}/cli.sh. Deliberately NOT touched, so this stays isolated and low-risk: the CLI and worker `caos` grammar and their sniffers (resolve_run_image / resolve_cli_image). `caos-cli run ` and `caos curry ` keep their positional form for now; collapsing them (and typing the map-then image positions) is checkpoint 2C. No redeploy needed: the collapse produces byte-identical arg trees (same base + args entries), so every seed key held and the outer stack kept answering during the suite. Only direct dev use of a stale deployed caos-cli against the new .caos-expr files would want `nix build && caosd up`. Suite: 33/33 green (no redeploy).
